messages:
Maya: anyone want to adopt the tiny ficus from my desk before I go on holiday? plant needs rehoming for 2 weeks. :)
Owen: I can take it for the week after next if no one else jumps in.
Priya: would love to but traveling then. can we add a watering note?
Maya: tag says water once on Mon and Thurs, indirect light. leaving a spare pot in the supply closet.
Ben: I can keep it safe in my office and drop by weekly. also can name it 'Sir Photosynth'.
Owen: yes to Sir Photosynth.
Priya: vote: Sir Photosynth = excellent name. :raised_hands:
ops-bot: Note: shared plants should be logged in the Office Inventory doc per policy (link: https://docs.internal/office-inventory).
Maya: thanks team! i'll leave it by the reception desk with a sticky note. please DM if you want it shipped after holidays.
Ben: RSVP: taking custody until 1/5. will send a plant pic when installed.
Maya: appreciate it!! :seedling:
